verdict.rationale: Godot's official repository states that one project exports with one click to the desktop platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows), mobile (Android, iOS) and consoles, which covers every target in the story. The evidence is a single first-party summary line, and the console path is only mentioned, not documented. missing for 10: detailed export docs for each platform, documentation of how console export works (direct vs. partner/porting), independent or hands-on corroboration of console and mobile exports

support.subject: As a studio lead, one project exports to desktop, mobile, and (directly or via partners) consoles

citations.quote: Games can be exported with one click to a number of platforms, including the major desktop platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows), mobile platforms (Android, iOS), as well as Web-based platforms and consoles.
